title: Thick with rough, scratchy fabric
text:
Thick with rough, scratchy fabric. Ok. I love a thick, soft comforter on every bed and we have ten of them in different styles and fabrics. I change our linens twice a week minimum so they also need to be washer and dryer safe. This one is a decent comforter in many ways and sort of blah at the same time.

It's thick and well stuffed so I think it will be warm this winter and all the rope style hems are well made. That same fabric is scratchy and rough to the touch - even the dogs don't like napping on the bare comforter. I washed and dried this thing before using it and it's still stiff and scratchy. It's a good, basic comforter, but we have three others that are much better for about half the cost.
